posts.title: I Am Morally Opposed to Updating My CLAUDE.md
posts.description: Every CLAUDE.md accumulates rules written in frustration after a single bad agent run, and never loses them. Why agent instruction files decay into a grievance archive, and what to do instead.

posts.title: 42 Is Not a Random Number
posts.description: MCP won and agents are everywhere, but they still fail in the same dumb ways. The fix isn't a smarter model. It's deterministic tools.

posts.title: Beating BERT? Small LLMs vs Fine-Tuned Encoders for Classification
posts.description: I ran 32 experiments comparing small LLMs to BERT on classification tasks. Turns out 2018-era BERT is still really good at what it does.
